# libgit2 / packfile_fuzzer

libgit2's own fuzz target `packfile_fuzzer` ([source](source/packfile_fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libgit2 (libgit2/libgit2 at 0551dfd4).

Feeds the input (minus a flag byte) to a git_indexer backed by an in-memory mempack ODB, optionally appending the SHA1 trailer, then git_indexer_commit and unlinks the written .idx/.pack; results only choose cleanup.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libgit2 at commit 0551dfd4 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- Per-input setup must succeed or abort(): after git_mempack_reset, git_odb_write of a constant 2-byte blob, git_indexer_new(".") and git_object_id_from_buffer over the input. Input-independent or trivially-true (except that mempack reset leaves the ODB writable) ([lines 74-101](source/packfile_fuzzer.c#L74-L101)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libgit2` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `packfile_fuzzer.plain` | 965,336 | `ed957e107b993c1aadf74fd6cd213c9f04b0b99081b1c911f605eb6b4c22b245` |
| ubsan | `packfile_fuzzer.ubsan` | 1,100,376 | `5c937c53975f8bbf7eedd3d5a715f5313caeb88529ddda921f844612dec03c1b` |
| asan | `packfile_fuzzer.asan` | 2,718,200 | `833f0feae11c4c108816a7219f1e88bd2027f546aedf56b48728b419c4a77cbb` |
| asan-ubsan | `packfile_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 2,802,968 | `c6c69dd73034500ad0a6b5f1060d08ffa97ec316660ed191ff453f474152b4ae` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
